newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian forex markets closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian forex markets closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: India's foreign exchange markets were closed on Monday for a Hindu festival and will reopen on Tuesday, dealers said.
On Friday the Indian rupee closed at 35.66/68 against the dollar opening the day steady at 35.65/66, dealers said.
"We saw some good demand (for dollars) today after a long lull," said a dealer at a foreign bank. He said a leading dollar buying bank was joined by several local banks on Friday.
